title: End of semester quiz preparation - marks clarification
document:
Dear all,

To help you prepare better for the quiz, please note the following marking scheme:

1. Single-answer questions No penalty for incorrect answers.

2. Multiple-answer questions Incorrect selections will incur a mark deduction. For example, if a question requires two answers and you select one correct and one incorrect option, you will receive +50% for the correct selection and −50% for the incorrect one.

This rule is in place to discourage guessing.

As for the topics covered, please find the following:

communication skills

research skills

meetings

teamwork and leadership

professional conduct

ERF (all steps)

Gibbs reflective cycle (the lecture slides provided here: https://learning.monash.edu/course/view.php?id=38191&section=52#section-54 )

Please ensure you arrive at least 10 mins before, as we will be taking your attendance. The quiz consists of 20 questions and takes 60 minutes. The venue will be updated on the Assessment page.

Hope this clarifies things.

Kind regards,

Nailah
